prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic fine-art portrait of an adult woman with pale natural skin, subtle freckles, deep gray-green eyes, and long dark hair softly windswept across her face. Her expression is calm, detached, and mysterious. She wears an elegant black high-neck gothic couture dress adorned with sculpted black roses across the chest. Place her centered and poised in a minimalist charcoal-gray studio with no props or text. Use soft directional studio light at approximately 4600K for gentle sculpting shadows, controlled cinematic contrast, and dimensional fabric and floral elements. Sony A7R V, 85mm f/1.8, mid-length portrait, shallow depth, muted monochrome palette, natural skin texture, subtle film grain, and cinematic softness.
